name: Sugarloaf Canyon world pieces (pass 3)
units: Roblox studs, +Y up, +X east, -Z north (world/world.json axes). 1 Blender unit = 1 stud.
fbx_export: Blender 5.2.2 LTS for pass2 affected files; prior files Blender 4.5; unit NONE, axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y, scale 1 (FBX_SCALE_UNITS), embedded PNG textures
import_settings: Import 3D at scale 1 (Stud), keep hierarchy: one MeshPart per material named <part>__<Material>. Anchored, CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch false (decoration only). CastShadow false where cast_shadow is false (cards, sky, Neon, glass cores) and on everything in far_card/sky.
placement: model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0)); pivot = piece base centre (see manifest origin). `scale` = per-axis resize factors (local X, Y, Z) applied to every MeshPart Size and its offset from the pivot.
strata: Vista palette deviation from course.md per Game Art Bot: cream, ochre, rose, muted terracotta; widths4/10/6/16 studs, soft edges; UV V=world y/36. SurfaceAppearance ColorMap textures/strata.png + RoughnessMap textures/strata_roughness.png; rose .48, others .84.
textures: textures/*.png 512x512 (tiling, 8-bit); card_*.png and sun_disc.png are RGBA alpha-cut cards
layout: layout.json (all instances; clusters list their merged world.json members)

motion.formula: Pivot (grip) path along a rope = two parabolic spans A->T (sag 10.0) and T->B (sag 2.5) in WORLD coords: P_span(w) = P + (Q - P)*w - (0, 4*sag*w*(1-w), 0), w in [0,1]. Pass 6: A (bottom attach) is 7.2 higher than pass 5 (world y 32.8); T and B unchanged. Travel: s(t) = 6*t studs of rope arc length; on span 1 (0 <= s <= L1) w solves arclen_AT(w) = s, on span 2 w solves arclen_TB(w) = s - L1. Numerically w ~= s/L1 (span 1) and (s-L1)/L2 (span 2) is within linear_w_max_error_studs of the exact arc-length position. Cabin stays level (hanger pivots), yaw constant: up line yaw 53.53 (front local -Z toward the top station), down line yaw 233.53 from B to A. Roblox: cabin:PivotTo(CFrame.new(P(t)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0)) each Heartbeat. At the tower crest T the path breaks from 23.5 deg up to -11.5 deg.
